title: ingress rule says episode-shaped writes only; every real ingest uses free-Turtle /knot
description: docs/design/ingress.md rule 1: every camayoc ingress goes through /episode (prov:wasGeneratedBy supplied, idempotent, no free-Turtle writes to governed planes). Reality: the only /episode calls in the repo are the four deliberately-invalid bootstrap probes; every successful ingest is POST /knot (bootstrap.sh:143, seed_knowledge.sh:61, reconcile_metrics.sh:33, tests). prov:wasGeneratedBy appears nowhere outside the design doc. Either move real ingest to /episode or narrow rule 1 to the planes it actually governs.
close_reason: Resolved by narrowing, the option this bead offered. Every claim verified true: the only /episode calls are the four invalid gate probes, every ingest is /knot, prov:wasGeneratedBy appears nowhere outside the design docs. ingress.md rule 1 now states the boundary it governs, keeps the disproved wording as recorded history, and names what the narrowing costs (actor+source is unchained, so a knot fact cannot be traced to its run). bootstrap.sh's ontology load named only its actor and now names its source -- the one write not meeting the floor the rule narrowed TO. tests/test_knot_provenance.py enforces it, driven off a search not a list. Commit 5facfdf.

title: gate proofs live only in the installer: no refusal tests, not in CI, probe grep defects
description: The untagged-write and falsifier refusals are proven only by scripts/bootstrap.sh probes (158-231). tests/test_metrics_slice.py has no negative arm; CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) runs markdownlint only. Two probe defects: (a) the grep at bootstrap.sh:163 matches curl stderr ('Connection refused' satisfies 'refus'), so a network failure can read as PROVEN; (b) the falsifier arm's probe body contains the word 'falsifier' and the grep alternation includes it, so a server echoing the accepted node back could false-positive as PROVEN. Add refusal tests, wire just test into CI, and tighten the probe detection to structured refusal output.
close_reason: Fixed: gate proofs extracted to scripts/gate_probe.sh so they run and are TESTED without an install; tests/test_gate_probe.py adds 11 arms over stub stores. Verdicts now read from designated JSON fields + HTTP status, never a grep over text the caller partly wrote. 'Could not look' (exit 3) split from 'gate is off' (exit 2). just test wired into CI. Defect (b) confirmed real and fixed. Defect (a)'s MECHANISM as filed is wrong -- curl -s prints nothing to stderr (exit 7, 0 bytes), so 2>&1 captured nothing; the reachable path is a proxy 502 body containing 'Connection refused', verified PROVEN/exit 0 against the old arm. Commit eb4069e.

title: quarantine planes are design-only: inferred facts are not routed to a low-trust plane
description: docs/design/ingress.md 53-63 defines crew:records/crew:declared/crew:inferred/code:* with lattice trust labels, but zero non-doc references exist — no script names a graph, no shape targets one, no query has a GRAPH clause. An inferred-tagged node lands exactly where an observed one does; quarantine is currently skill discipline only. Provisional D (docs/patents/provisional-grounding-cluster.md section 3.3) discloses the enforced router as the primary contemplated embodiment: gate derives target plane from sourceKind. Implement the routing plus quipu lattice labels on the planes.
notes: MEASURED BLOCKED 2026-08-17 (Claude), with citations -- a 'built' blocker per ingress.md 1.8, not a stated one. Read quipu's source: it HAS the quad store (src/store/migrate.rs:33), GRAPH/FROM NAMED (src/sparql/pattern.rs:352-372), the full trust lattice (src/lattice.rs) and query-time floors (src/store/labels.rs:730). Two gaps, both quipu's: (1) /knot cannot target a graph -- hardcoded to ROOT (src/rdf.rs:180-182) -- and every real camayoc ingest is a /knot write; its body is free-form JSON with no unknown-field rejection, so a 'graph' key is SILENTLY DROPPED and routing would look implemented while doing nothing. (2) no HTTP or CLI route sets a graph label; the only caller of set_graph_label is src/pack.rs:450, and a graph /episode creates is interned but not registered so set_graph_label would refuse it anyway (src/store/labels.rs:344-350 vs src/episode/mod.rs:371). ORDERING is why this is not partially shipped: routing without labels gives separate graphs every query still reads at equal trust -- quarantine's appearance without its substance. Full writeup in docs/design/ingress.md section 2.1. A test now pins that no /knot payload carries a 'graph' key. UNBLOCK: quipu needs a graph-register route and a label-set route; camayoc then moves agent-recorded facts to /episode with graph derived from sourceKind.

title: shapes: code-entity shapes do not require sourceKind — seed writes are untagged in the graph
description: docs/design/ingress.md rule 2 says every fact carries camayoc:sourceKind from the first load, but none of the 7 NodeShapes in shapes/code-entities.ttl (CodeModule, CodeSymbol, Document, Section, Bundle, Commit) requires it. The seed_knowledge.sh walk is therefore untagged in the graph; 'observed by construction' exists only as prose (seed_knowledge.sh:10-12). Either extend the tag to code-entity shapes or record the exemption as a deliberate, documented boundary.
close_reason: Resolved via the SECOND option this bead offered ('record the exemption as a deliberate, documented boundary'), and the distinction matters: sourceKind is now constrained WHEN PRESENT on all four code-entity shapes (sh:in observed|declared|inferred, sh:maxCount 1, with an sh:message naming this bead), but sh:minCount was deliberately NOT added. So the titled symptom stands: a seed write with no tag is still accepted. That is the exemption, not an oversight -- shapes/code-entities.ttl states four times that it must never require a predicate the emitter does not emit, and ingest_repos.py does not emit sourceKind. Adding minCount would have made every seed refuse, turning a governance gap into a broken installer. Anyone wanting the strict form must change the emitter FIRST, then add minCount; doing it in the other order breaks the walk. Reopen if that emitter change lands.

title: Competency-gap detection: a question resolving to no competency question is an ontology gap
description: quipu docs/design/semantic-grounded-edit-policies.md, Further applications #6. Embed the competency-question suite; an incoming question whose best match falls below threshold is reported as NO COVERAGE — an ontology gap surfaced as its own outcome, never silently answered from the nearest term. The Empty/Partial/Full discipline applied to the ontology's own reach; gaps become candidate beads for new competency questions. Stage-1 advisory under the identify-and-inform-before-refusing ordering.
notes: PARTIALLY IMPLEMENTED 2026-08-17 (Claude). Done, needing no model: scripts/competency.py parses the suite (47 questions across 3 files -- numbers restart per file and skip, questions wrap, Acceptance sections carry numbered non-questions; all three would have corrupted a corpus silently), the verdict shape (method/semantic/floor/full/suite_size/corpus_watermark), Empty|Partial|Full, and gaps rendered as P3 pitch beads. 18 tests, just competency wired. Every verdict carries method='lexical-jaccard-v1' and semantic=false, and a test forbids the label containing any word mistakable for meaning-awareness -- the inverse of camayoc's own rule that inferred facts never masquerade. NOT DONE: the embedding scorer. Measured, not assumed: models/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 has tokenizer.json + config.json and NO weights, because the xet CDN the download redirects to answers 403 on CONNECT (na-6td). test_a_paraphrase_is_missed pins the lexical matcher's real failure mode; when weights land it SHOULD fail, and the fix is to change METHOD, not to relax the threshold. Thresholds are uncalibrated and every verdict says so by carrying them. Commit 9aa059b.

title: Settled-decision collision: similarity-check new Decision episodes against crew:declared before the write
description: quipu docs/design/semantic-grounded-edit-policies.md, Further applications #2. Before an agent's Decision episode lands, compare its embedding against standing human decisions in crew:declared; a match above threshold surfaces 'duplicates or conflicts with a settled decision' as advisory or escalation BEFORE the write. Convention memory made enforceable: the store notices re-litigation. Same disciplines: score/threshold/model/corpus-watermark in the verdict, nonzero OperatingPoint, advisory/escalate only, recorded facts land sourceKind=inferred. Depends on the quarantine planes existing (camayoc-s0h) and the grounding vocabulary (quipu-3aj, quipu tracker).
notes: BLOCKED 2026-08-17 (Claude): depends on camayoc-s0h, which is now measured-blocked on two specific quipu gaps (no graph targeting on /knot, no label-set route) -- see s0h's notes for citations. Also depends on the grounding vocabulary (quipu-3aj). Building the similarity check before the planes exist would land its inferred verdicts in the same plane as observed facts, which is the exact thing it is meant to prevent.

title: idempotency rule (branch on outcome, never count) not followed by camayoc's own scripts
description: skills/camayoc/SKILL.md 52-54 teaches agents to branch on outcome, never count; seed_knowledge.sh:67-69 parses count and conforms for its status line, and no script branches on outcome. ingest_metrics.py achieves convergence differently (deterministic aegis:contentHash, byte-stability tested). Align the scripts with the discipline they teach, or document why the seed path is exempt.
close_reason: Fixed: the seed now parses JSON instead of scraping with sed, branches on outcome with 'unchanged' stated as success, treats conforms:false as the refusal it is (exit 2 with the issues), and demotes count to a labelled detail. Three defects each reproduced against the old expression first: greedy .*"count" picked the LAST match (9999 over a real 7 with a nested stats.count); conforms:false at HTTP 200 printed a status line then said 'done' and exited 0; a count of 0 led every converged run. tests/test_seed_report.py drives the real script against stub stores. Commits 883bebf, 320d27c.

title: promotion out of crew:inferred is unimplemented (authority-gated graph move)
description: docs/design/ingress.md 109-111 defines promotion as a governed graph move requiring authority over the target plane; skills/camayoc/SKILL.md 82-83 states the agent-facing rule. No implementation exists. Depends on the quarantine planes existing first (camayoc-s0h). Note shapes/code-entities.ttl uses 'promotion' for an unrelated bobbin-to-quipu mechanism — naming collision worth resolving when this lands.
notes: BLOCKED 2026-08-17 (Claude): promotion is a graph MOVE between planes, and the planes do not exist -- camayoc-s0h is measured-blocked on quipu (see its notes). There is also nothing to promote out of, since inferred facts currently land where observed ones do. Naming collision flagged in the bead (shapes/code-entities.ttl uses 'promotion' for an unrelated bobbin-to-quipu mechanism) still stands and should be resolved when this lands.
